sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the complete DIRECT_CALCULATION contract: all declared operands and the result are targeted on webFrame with the supplied units, the Table 4-8 ratio/alpha alternatives are checked independently, and the derived area uses the declared formula with direct IF-based absolute difference and tolerance scaled from the expected result. Deterministic validation is valid and no repair is required.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the SPARQL logic so the formula comparison is evaluated for every supplied webFrame. The current FILTER(!validTablePair) suppresses violations whenever ratio and alpha form a valid Table 4-8 pair, allowing any requiredShearArea value to pass.
